integrity: Analytical theorem with finite numerical cross-checks; no independent external validation or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent one-dimensional Brownian searchers with Poisson positive-integer production batches, exponential mortality, one perfectly absorbing target, initially empty population. The power-law amplification assumes pointwise batch probabilities asymptotic to c*j^(-1-alpha); no measurement-noise robustness, nonexponential mortality, or arbitrary renewal production is asserted.
title: Sharp burst-tail amplification in the population present at first target binding
